```python
    if start == n:
        return None, -1

        # Unquoted field

        while end < n and line[end] != ',':

        field = line[start:end]
```

```python
def next_field(line, start):
    n = len(line)
    if start >= n:
        return None, -1
    
    if line[start] != '"':
        # Handle unquoted field
        i = line.find(',', start)
        if i == -1:
            i = n
        field = line[start:i]
        next_start = i + 1
    else:
        # Handle quoted field
        i = start + 1
        field = []
        while i < n and line[i] != '"':
            if line[i] == '\\':
                i += 1
            field.append(line[i])
            i += 1
        if i == n:
            raise ValueError("Unmatched quotes in CSV field")
        field = ''.join(field)
        next_start = i + 1
    
    return field, next_start
```

```python
def next_field(line, start):
    if start >= len(line):
        return None, -1
    
    if line[start] != '"':
        # Unquoted field
        end = line.find(',', start)
        field = line[start:end] if end != -1 else line[start:]
        next_start = end + 1 if end != -1 else len(line)
        return field, next_start
    
    # Quoted field
    start += 1
    end = start
    escape = False
    
    while end < len(line):
        if line[end] == '"' and not escape:
            break
        if line[end] == '\\':
            escape = True
        else:
            escape = False
        end += 1
    
    field = line[start:end].replace('""', '"')
    next_start = end + 2
    return field, next_start
```
